newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman EPS raised.

text.p: -- Brown Bros Harriman analyst Raphael Soifer said in a research note that he raised his 1997 earnings estimate for Lehman Bros Holdings Inc to $3.75 per share from $3.30.

-- "According to our calculations, were Lehman to make its return on equity target (15 percent in 1997) earnings per share for 1997 would be approximately $4.20 versus a comparable 1996 figure ... of $3.67. With our outlook calling for the resumption of a long-term bear market in bonds, probably in the second half of the year, we're not quite so optimistic but we're impressed with Lehman's performance during 1996 as well as by the steps it is taking to improve results going forward ... ."
